title: Chromium browser profiles
whyItMatters: Chromium keeps browsing history, sessions, bookmarks and saved logins per profile. Anyone who takes the disk can see what was browsed and which sites kept the user signed in.
source: Arch Wiki, Chromium: the profile is kept in ~/.config/chromium and follows the Chromium user data layout: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Chromium
notes: Distribution Chromium, not Chrome; both can be installed side by side. Matches the Preferences marker file so non-profile folders are skipped. The Chromium snap keeps the same tree under ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium instead of ~/.config/chromium.
